correctness.rationale: Two exactly equivalent membership predicates (maximum induced degree <=1, forbidden center-with-two-neighbors triple) exhaust each of 2^(2^d) vertex subsets through d4. Independent enumeration reproduced d4 3054 nonempty faces and dimension f-vector (16,120,464,964,960,440,80,10). The inspected complete verify.py constructs an acyclic discrete Morse matching, checks all 13568 directed Hasse incidences via topological sort, leaves 1 zero-cell, 16 three-cells and a single four-cell. Signed exact integral projection of the single critical 4-cell 0x4a30 to 16 critical 3-cells is identically zero. Its 3-skeleton is wedge^16 S3 and Hurewicz gives pi3~=H3, making the attaching map null and proving the asserted integral mixed wedge, not merely mod2 Betti agreement. Our independent bounded computation fully enumerated faces but the complete supplied Morse projection was source-inspected rather than separately run.
